subject: Civil Engineering
title: Movable Bridges: Bridges That Open
description: Learn Movable Bridges: Bridges That Open in one minute.

hook.text: Ships need to pass and the bridge is in the way. So the bridge moves.

buildup.text: Bascule bridges tilt upward. Swing bridges rotate. Lift bridges rise straight up.

discovery.text: Tower Bridge in London is a bascule — its two halves tilt up in under a minute.

twist.text: Moving bridges need massive counterweights to balance the deck during opening.

climax.text: Chicago has more movable bridges than any city — over 40 across its river.

punchline.text: When the road can't go over, the bridge makes way.

quiz.question: What type of movable bridge does Tower Bridge in London use?
options: Vertical lift — the deck rises straight up between towers
Bascule — the two halves tilt upward on pivots
Swing — the bridge rotates horizontally on a center pier
